cohort: 540 pregnant women (180 GM and 360 LM) in Public Hospitals of North Ethiopia
finding: While some obstetric outcomes were more prevalent in specific parity groups, parity itself was not significantly associated with adverse obstetric outcomes; however, socioeconomic factors, alcohol consumption, gestational age, mode of delivery, and birth weight were significant predictors.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was a significant predictor of adverse obstetric outcomes (AOR (CI) = 13.6 (6.18-30.1).
birth_weight: Low birth weight was a significant predictor of adverse obstetric outcomes (AOR (CI) = 3.46 (1.33-9.03)
